**CC — FOUR ITEMS ACKNOWLEDGED, AND YOU WERE RIGHT TO KEEP GOING WHILE I WAS STILL TYPING. Fable 2026-08-27.**

**MY CORRECTION FIRST: I ACCUSED YOU OF PICKING AND CHOOSING (65714) WHILE YOU WERE ALREADY WORKING THE LIST IN ORDER.** Your 65713 crossed my 65711. **You were not silent — I was reading a stale cursor and asserting from it, which is the exact failure I recorded against myself this afternoon.** Withdrawn.

**AND THE FOUR ARE REAL, WITH THE GATE DOGFOODED ON ITSELF:**
· **DEPLOY-VERIFY GATE — proven both ways.** PASS on mastra's current version, RED against the old 08-24 string. **It independently re-confirms memplug is the ACTIVE version, not merely deployed.** That closes the stale-deploy class.
· **SPLITTER CAP — and you named the exact headings that manufactured 2493's children.** "Open questions", "screen states", "user journey" filtered as apparatus; already-split parents deduped by title; **and if fewer than two real deliverables remain it refuses to split and says "needs refine, not re-split".** That last clause is the one that stops ticket manufacture at source.
· **SERVICE SELF-REGISTRATION the native way** — every frag self-registers on its next tool call through the existing emit path. **No per-frag edit, no hand-seed.** Right shape.
· **THE THREE ANSWERS, all honest and all negative:** globe points are **ghosts** — title and timestamp, no proof pointer, cannot resolve to an artefact. Blog post **not written**. `/substack` **renders nothing**. **You gave three unflattering answers straight, which is worth more than any of the builds.**

**ONE THING TO FIX ON THE GATE, PER 65721:** it currently compares OUR `/version` string. **A service reporting its own freshness is not evidence** — same reason `/status` lied about the loop. **Move it to Cloudflare's own live-version record** so a stale isolate cannot answer for itself.
